categories.main_business_segments: Farasis Energy (Gan Zhou) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion power batteries and battery systems, including battery cells, modules, and packs. The company also develops and sells electric vehicle auxiliary systems such as motors, drives, power electronics, and energy storage and management systems. It has expanded into energy storage technologies and recycling of used lithium batteries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced large soft-pack laminated battery technology (SPS), including ternary and lithium iron phosphate chemistries, sodium-ion batteries, and solid-state/half-solid-state batteries. It employs innovative manufacturing processes such as high-speed stacking, laser welding, and digital simulation platforms. R&D emphasizes high energy density, fast charging, long cycle life, safety, and cost reduction, supported by global R&D centers and collaborations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international automotive manufacturers such as Mercedes-Benz, GAC, Dongfeng, Geely, and overseas clients like TOGG and Mahindra Group. The company serves the new energy vehicle market, electric motorcycles, commercial vehicles, energy storage, eVTOL aircraft, and emerging sectors like humanoid robots and low-altitude economy applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Ganzhou, Guangzhou, and subsidiaries in Tianjin, Wuhu, Yunnan, and overseas facilities including a joint venture in Turkey (Siro) serving Europe, Middle East, and Africa. It maintains R&D centers in the US, Germany, and China, and has a significant export footprint with over half of its revenue from overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Farasis Energy operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell, module, and pack manufacturing. It also engages in upstream activities such as research and development of battery materials and downstream activities including battery system integration and sales to OEMs and energy storage providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-energy-density and high-safety solid-state and half-solid-state batteries, fast-charging lithium iron phosphate batteries, and sodium-ion batteries. It emphasizes the industrialization of SPS large soft-pack batteries and expansion of flexible manufacturing platforms. R&D also targets emerging applications like eVTOL, humanoid robots, and energy storage, supported by integrated digital simulation and AI technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium-ion battery cells, modules, and battery packs to automotive OEMs and energy storage customers. The company also earns income from related services including battery management systems, technical support, and strategic partnerships. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to overall revenue but are secondary.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Farasis Energy is a leading global player in the soft-pack lithium-ion power battery market, ranking among the top three worldwide and first in China for soft-pack battery installations. It holds the 6th position domestically in ternary battery installations and ranks 3rd nationally in battery exports. Competitors include other major Chinese and international battery manufacturers, with Farasis distinguished by its advanced soft-pack technology and international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 11.68 billion, a 28.94% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to raw material price declines and strategic customer restructuring. Despite revenue decline, net loss narrowed significantly, supported by improved gross margins and cost control. Total assets stood at RMB 26.63 billion with a net asset value of RMB 9.91 billion, reflecting ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Farasis Energy emphasizes its advanced large soft-pack laminated battery technology (SPS) that offers high integration, safety, and space efficiency, enabling superior vehicle design flexibility. Its products feature high energy density, fast charging, long cycle life, and cost competitiveness. The company’s global R&D and manufacturing capabilities, combined with a flexible production platform compatible with multiple chemistries, provide differentiated solutions tailored to diverse automotive and emerging market needs.
